caption: The drawing depicts a single, bulbous vase with a narrow neck and a small circular opening at the top, positioned upright in the center of a plain, off-white background. The surface of the vase is predominantly a deep reddish-brown color and is adorned with a decorative floral design. The flowers, which have large, rounded petals and prominent venation, along with their leaves and stems, are rendered in white and light gray tones, creating a strong contrast with the dark background of the vase. The floral pattern wraps around both the body and neck of the vase, with some of the stems curling and intertwining. There are also narrow bands of white encircling the vase at the mouth, neck, and base. The drawing is signed “M. Arnold” near the lower right of the vase. There are no other objects in the composition.
title: Vase
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
